Connolly Station

We offer Self-Guided Tours by Appointment Only. Experience small-town charm while enjoying a downtown lifestyle with conveniences a short distance away at Connolly Station apartments in Dublin, CA.

Choose from our portfolio of one-, two-, and three-bedroom floor plans, including a 2-story townhome-style layout. Each apartment home for rent features conveniences like air conditioning and an in-home washer and dryer, enhanced by interior finishes like stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. Select homes also include a private patio or balcony to extend your living space outdoors.

Just outside your door, you’ll find our community has everything you need. Take a dip in the pool, relax on the sundeck, or work up a sweat in the fitness center. Need more room? Our pet-friendly community has plenty of space to stretch out and entertain. Host friends and neighbors for the game in our recreation room or picnic in our barbecue area. All of this is accompanied by our top-notch staff dedicated to ensuring that our community continuously meets your standards.

Connolly Station is ideally positioned with walkability and commuting in mind. Dublin’s suburban vibe is complemented by a city center that puts everyday conveniences like grocery stores, retail shops, and restaurants within easy reach. Commuting is convenient with BART in proximity and interstates 580 and 680 nearby for travel by car.

Price reflected is base rent and does not include mandatory or optional fees. Detailed fee information and fee schedules can be found on the community's Leasing Info page on our Essex website.

Dublin

Sister city to Dublin, Ireland, Dublin, CA is the second fastest-growing city in California and for good reason. Its small-town charm, rich culture, and reasonable distance from San Francisco make it a great place to live–and the St. Patrick’s Day celebration is absolutely unrivaled.
